site.name: Yingbo Fan
site.title: Postdoctoral Researcher
site.affiliation: School of Earth and Space Sciences, Peking University
site.tagline: Multimodal intelligence for understanding, predicting, and acting in complex spaces.
site.mission: I develop multimodal spatial intelligence that integrates visual perception, 3D geometry, language, and dynamics. My research focuses on efficient world models and grounded decision-making, with intelligent mining as a defining real-world frontier.
site.description: Academic homepage of Yingbo Fan, a researcher in multimodal spatial intelligence, world models, embodied AI, and intelligent mining at Peking University.

researchArc.title: Multimodal Spatial Intelligence
researchArc.description: Fuse panoramic vision, 3D geometry, language, and multi-source sensing into structured representations of complex environments.

researchArc.title: Efficient World Models
researchArc.description: Learn compact predictive representations of spatial dynamics for imagination, simulation, and planning under constrained computation.

researchArc.title: Embodied and Industrial Intelligence
researchArc.description: Translate spatial understanding and predictive models into grounded action for embodied agents and intelligent mining systems.

featured.title: CARVE-VLA
featured.alt: Concept illustration for CARVE-VLA showing visual observations, language, an embodied agent, and action trajectories.
featured.description: A vision-language-action framework that grounds multimodal reasoning in spatial structure, connecting visual observations, language, world state, and action.

featured.title: Lightweight World Models
featured.alt: Concept illustration of compact latent states supporting prediction and planning.
featured.description: A first-principles investigation of compact predictive models that preserve imagination and planning capability while reducing inference cost.

featured.title: One Sphere, Many Charts
featured.subtitle: Group-Consistent Panoramic Depth from Frozen Foundation Models
featured.alt: Concept illustration of a sphere decomposed into multiple charts for panoramic depth estimation.
featured.description: A geometry-aware approach that transfers frozen foundation models to panoramic depth estimation through chart-based representations and group consistency.
